mapper.select: SELECT T.ID, T.TEMPLATE_TYPE, T.TEMPLATE_CODE, T.BUCKET_NAME, T.OBJECT_NAME, T.STATUS FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE T WHERE T.ID = #{id}
SELECT T.ID, T.TEMPLATE_TYPE, T.TEMPLATE_CODE, T.BUCKET_NAME, T.OBJECT_NAME, T.STATUS FROM E_PRINT_TEMPLATE T WHERE T.TEMPLATE_TYPE = #{templateType} AND T.TEMPLATE_CODE = #{templateCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO E_PRINT_TEMPLATE ( ID, TEMPLATE_TYPE, TEMPLATE_CODE, BUCKET_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_E_PRINT_TEMPLATE.NEXTVAL, #{templateType}, #{templateCode}, #{bucketName}, #{objectName}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE E_PRINT_TEMPLATE SET TEMPLATE_TYPE = #{templateType}, TEMPLATE_CODE = #{templateCode}, BUCKET_NAME = #{bucketName}, OBJECT_NAME = #{objectName}, STATUS = #{status} WHERE ID = #{id}
